core.title: Stonewashed Bronze Ribbon Cabinet Pull, Laurey 38576

text.description_html:
Laurey 38576, Ribbon Stonewashed Bronze Cabinet Pull

The Ribbon Stonewashed Bronze Cabinet Pull is unique in that it can be mounted with either 3 inch mounting centers or 4 inch mounting centers. The Ribbon Stonewashed Bronze Pull measures 5 inches overall. This lightweight cabinet pull is an affordable way to update your kitchen's hardware. Each cabinet pull comes packaged with the mounting screws. The Ribbon Stonewashed Bronze Cabinet Pull has a transitional style that is sure to catch eyes and turn heads.

This cabinet pull is part of the Laurey Ribbon Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 38576 Ribbon Pull in Stonewashed Bronze:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Stonewashed Bronze
  • Length c.c. (center to center): Adjustable 3" or 4"
  • Overall Length: 5"
  • Width: 7/8"
  • Projection: 1-1/8"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.
